items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: My band was still up then. And that's where I told them we had Maurice and, uh, Rika Ellis.

ctx.x: I'll say. I'll say. I'll say.

I'll say. I'll say. I'll say. My band was still up then. And that's where I told them we had Maurice and, uh, Rika Ellis. I'll say. Rika Ellis. Rika Ellis. I don't know why Rika left us, but we got, uh, uh, Maurice here. He just come from World of War, you know. First World of War, you know. And then he got in and I'm going to start the bossing, you know. And we said, yeah, we're all young boys, you know, get a band over in the community, try to run all bands along as we've been up. And that's why we kept on and…
I used to lead it for him to catch it. He said, when he catch it, he had a good laugh.
